name: Widow / Destitute Women Pension Scheme - Punjab
_eligibility_text:
1. Beneficiary should be a Permanent Resident of Punjab .
1. The Annual Income of Beneficiary should not be more than Rs. 60,000/-per year .
1. The below mentioned women are eligible for monthly pension :-

   1. Widow Women.
   1. Destitute Women.
   1. Unmarried Women.

1. The Age of the beneficiary should be :- 

   1. Widow or Destitute Women: Below 58 Years.
   1. Unmarried Women: Above 30 Years.
